item.title: He died of 'natural causes.' But his mother says she knows what killed him: heat
item.description: When Arizona counts heat-related deaths, Adam Willson isn't included. His story shows how thousands of heat deaths can go uncounted every year in the United States.
item.content:encoded:
When Arizona counts heat-related deaths, Adam Willson isn't included. His story shows how thousands of heat deaths can go uncounted every year in the United States.

(Image credit: Ryan Kellman)

item.title: NPR spent 2 years tracking deaths from heat. We found a staggering hidden toll
item.description: An NPR investigation found that people in the U.S. are dying from heat much more often than official counts show. We explore the reasons why — and how lives can be saved.
item.content:encoded: An NPR investigation found that people in the U.S. are dying from heat much more often than official counts show. We explore the reasons why — and how lives can be saved.

item.title: Why too many women are prescribed antibiotics for UTIs they don't have
item.description: A recent study found that many women treated for recurrent UTIs didn't have UTIs at all. Instead, their symptoms were caused by hormonally driven inflammation and pelvic floor dysfunction.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: New Jersey is a fossil hotspot, with answers about the day the dinosaurs died
item.description: Paleontologist Ken Lacovara never expected to find critical fossil data in a New Jersey suburb—let alone info about the asteroid that killed the dinosaurs. His dig site is now a fossil park and museum.
